newsitem.title: USA: DynaGen, Smith & Nephew in license deal.
newsitem.headline: DynaGen, Smith & Nephew in license deal.

text.p: DynaGen Inc said Monday that it has an agreement which could lead to Smith & Nephew Plc acquiring the patent license for the manufacture and sale of DynaGen's OrthoDyn bone substitute material for use in orthopaedic and maxillofacial applications.

Under the agreement, Smith & Nephew will have 12 months in which to perform an exclusive technical evaluation of DynaGen's OrthoDyn bone substitute material, after which it will have the option of acquiring an exclusive patent license to the material.
Financial terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
